meta.title: DeepSeek Hermes Skin
meta.description: A paper-and-gold ink skin: thinking-depth pills, a daily divination ritual (draw, card, talisman cast, hexagram slip), and a four-stage bagua boot curtain. V3 embeds the open-source Ziwei Dou Shu chart engine: a ziwei badge beside the model label with a chart-to-draft reasoning mode, plus a twelve-palace natal chart for every conversation and workspace.
